stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

on the last line of your reply:

{
 "title": "Implement and verify task transform",
 "workdir": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u024/system/state/workspace",
 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-009ad50e.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Mirror each occupied tile block into its empty immediate right neighbor."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r] and grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    original = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-2):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            d0, d1 = cbounds[ci+1]+1, cbounds[ci+2]
            source = [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if original[r][c] != 0]
            target_filled = any(original[r][c] != 0 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(d0, d1))
            if source and not target_filled and (c1-c0) == (d1-d0):
                for r, c in source:
                    out[r][d0 + (c1-1-c)] = original[r][c]
    return out
PY
